added: 截图里直接识别表格：认出的表格盖在原来的位置上，样子和原图几乎一样，像 Excel 一样框选、打字、复制粘贴、撤销，还能导出 Excel
截图里直接识别公式：公式原位显示，可以改 LaTeX，复制 LaTeX 或 MathML
选区里有好几张表、或者表格和公式混在一起时，自动分开认，每张表各自盖在原处
本地公式识别（设置 → 文字识别里下载）：不用 AI，印刷体公式一般不到一秒就认出来
可以给「识别表格 / 公式」单独选一个更快的 AI 模型，对话照样用原来的
录屏合并成一个「录制」按钮：先进录制准备，选格式（MP4 / GIF / APNG）、倒计时、麦克风、系统声音、摄像头，再开始
录制时可以显示鼠标点击、鼠标轨迹、滚动和按下的键，加进度条或播放时间，拖右下角把手挪动录制区域
录完可以先剪辑：掐头去尾、0.5–4 倍速（声音不变调）
Windows 也能录 MP4 视频，带系统声音、麦克风和摄像头
截图标注新工具：荧光笔、序号、橡皮擦、测量、水印、标注模板，还有聚光灯和放大镜
截图时识别二维码 / 条码，点一下复制或打开链接
选区可以输入坐标和宽高、锁定比例，支持自由形状选区和延时截图
取色时按 P 把颜色贴到桌面上，HEX / RGB / HSL 一键复制
贴图里的文字可以直接选中复制；贴图能旋转、翻转、鼠标穿透，也能恢复刚关掉的贴图
选区框的拖柄可以选「半圆条」，只露出框外的一半，不挡选区里的内容；录屏时的拖柄单独设置
划词小圆点可以自定义液态玻璃效果（色差、模糊、折射等），调整时有实时预览
设置页可以搜索（Ctrl+F / ⌘F），在搜索结果里直接修改
界面语言新增繁體中文、日本語、한국어
improved: 截图翻译按表格格子原位翻译，粗体和字号跟着原文，纯数字不再重画
识别公式快了一倍以上
待机时占用的内存减少约一半
截图工具条新增扁平样式，磨砂玻璃样式在拖动、录制时也不会丢
录制准备时不再压暗屏幕，录制框以外的窗口照常可以点；录制中也能截图
截图时框选整张表更准：贴着表格边或在表格外侧不远处都能框到整张表
二级工具条展开时不再从屏幕左上角飞进来
fixed: 划词翻译面板的圆角有锯齿，截图里四个角露出方块或台阶（Windows）
主窗口收进任务栏 / 程序坞后，用划词或截图时主窗口会自己跳出来
表格只有表头上下两道线时，整张表被认成一行
录制时副屏上的控制条点不中

added: Recognize tables right in a screenshot: the table is laid back over the original, looking almost the same, and you can select, type, copy, paste and undo like in Excel, or export it to Excel
Recognize formulas right in a screenshot: the formula is shown in place, you can edit its LaTeX and copy LaTeX or MathML
When the selection contains several tables, or tables mixed with formulas, each is recognized separately and laid over its own spot
Local formula recognition (download it in Settings → Text recognition): no AI needed, printed formulas are usually read in under a second
Pick a separate, faster AI model just for table and formula recognition while chat keeps using yours
Screen recording is now one Record button: set up the format (MP4 / GIF / APNG), countdown, microphone, system audio and camera first, then start
Show mouse clicks, the mouse trail, scrolling and key presses while recording, add a progress bar or elapsed time, and move the recording area with the corner handle
Trim recordings and change their speed (0.5–4×, pitch preserved) before saving
MP4 recording on Windows, with system audio, microphone and camera
New annotation tools: highlighter, numbered markers, eraser, measure, watermark and templates, plus spotlight and magnifier
Scan QR codes and barcodes while capturing, then copy or open the link with one click
Enter the selection's position and size, lock the aspect ratio, draw freeform selections, or take delayed screenshots
Press P while picking a color to pin it on the desktop, with one-click HEX / RGB / HSL copy
Select and copy text inside pinned screenshots; rotate, flip and click through pins, and bring back the one you just closed
Half-bar selection handles that only show the outer half so nothing inside the selection is covered; recording has its own handle setting
Customize the liquid-glass look of the selection dot (dispersion, blur, refraction and more) with a live preview
Search Settings (Ctrl+F / ⌘F) and change options right in the results
New interface languages: Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Korean
improved: Screenshot translation now works cell by cell in tables, keeps bold text and font sizes, and leaves plain numbers alone
Formula recognition is more than twice as fast
About half the memory use while idle
A new flat capture toolbar style; the frosted-glass style no longer drops while dragging or recording
Recording setup no longer dims the screen, windows outside the area stay usable, and you can take screenshots while recording
Picking a whole table while capturing is more accurate, even when the pointer is on the table's edge or just outside it
The secondary toolbar no longer flies in from the top-left corner of the screen
fixed: Jagged corners on the translation popup, and square or stepped corners on it in screenshots (Windows)
The main window popped up during text selection or capture after being minimized to the taskbar / Dock
Tables with only lines above and below the header were read as a single row
Recording controls on a secondary display couldn't be clicked
